Image 2 is the ACTUAL SELECTED MODEL: this is authoritative for visible head identity, hairstyle, hair colour, skin tone, face coverings and head accessories. Match that actual model rather than copying an incorrect default portrait. Preserve Shin's youthful male face and spiky hairstyle, but match this model's bright white hair, normal warm tan skin. ONLY HEAD and a tiny bare neck, absolutely NO scarf, collar, clothing, armour or effects. Different outfits with this same visible head will share this asset. Composition: a single large centred complete head and tiny bare neck, nearly frontal slight three-quarter view toward the viewer's right with both eyes visible where the model permits. Full hair silhouette intact, about 85% of square canvas with 5% clear margin on every side. Genuine alpha transparency. Warm painted edge light and soft dimensional shading, fine clean hair detail, distinct readable eyes at 90px. Absolutely NO shoulders, chest, arms, hands, weapons, aura, scenery, UI, medallion, circular mask, frame, labels, text or watermark. One head only, no contact sheet. Preserve any actual hat or headband present on the model, but never invent one.
